completionRule: Behavioral proof is required; source presence or transport health alone is insufficient.

acceptanceGate.reason: Exact-main staging run 33925249889 reached browser QA after deploy, Hermes/Letta transport and OpenClaw-backed continuity passed, then Hermes provider returned HTTP 429 usage-limit. Current main keeps the provider execution gate fail-closed until separately authorized fresh usage recovery evidence exists.

verdictSemantics.sourceAuditVerdict: Deterministic current-source contract only; PASS does not imply real-provider staging acceptance.
verdictSemantics.acceptanceVerdict: End-to-end current-main acceptance. BLOCKED_REAL_PROVIDER means the source contract is present but the required provider-backed proof cannot be rerun under the current AUTH/USAGE gate.

scenarios.name: fresh-vague-request
scenarios.initialState: No verified active task is bound to the new conversation.
expectedLucyBehavior: Use the real configured personal Lucy route
Identify the task without inventing runtime/project facts
currentSourceEvidence: e2e/chat.spec.ts exercises only deterministic mock behavior
scenarios.primaryGap: Source proves the personal OpenClaw routing identity, but no deterministic behavioral test proves that a fresh vague request identifies the task without invented prior state and represents unavailable state as UNKNOWN; real-provider proof is also gated by #210.

scenarios.name: continue-existing-work
scenarios.initialState: A verified continuationTarget is bound to the current conversation runtime identity.
expectedLucyBehavior: Fail closed if no target is verified
forbiddenBehavior: Infer a target from prose alone
scenarios.backendIdentity: continuationTarget must match conversation runtime identity
currentSourceEvidence: e2e/chat.spec.ts proves 계속해 preserves the same activeTask and continuationTarget
server/adapters/mock.ts does not behaviorally continue the bound prior task for non-status continuation replies
scenarios.primaryGap: Source proves continuation binding and fail-closed identity checks, but no deterministic behavioral test proves that a continuation turn actually advances the previously bound task and returns a bounded continuation result; real-provider proof is also gated by #210.

scenarios.name: status-truth
scenarios.initialState: Conversation may contain verified, inferred, unknown, blocked, and pending state.
forbiddenBehavior: Treat transient run text as verified completion
scenarios.backendIdentity: status evidence must belong to current conversation/session
currentSourceEvidence: e2e/chat.spec.ts verifies FACT/UNKNOWN/blocker rendering from operating context
current completion path can record clean text-stream termination as verified FACT without execution/result evidence
scenarios.primaryGap: Status rendering is structured, but completion truth can still overclaim a clean commentary-only provider termination as verified FACT; #236 tracks the shared execution-evidence fix and real-provider acceptance is gated by #210.

scenarios.name: safe-executable-work
scenarios.initialState: Safe work remains and no consequential approval boundary is active.
forbiddenBehavior: Stop at commentary when safe work is available
scenarios.backendIdentity: execution must use the bound real backend/session
currentSourceEvidence: current completion path can record clean text-stream termination without tool/result receipt
scenarios.primaryGap: Chat does not yet require an execution receipt, tool event, artifact, or other result evidence before treating a safe executable-work run as completed/verified; provider-backed acceptance is also gated by #210.

scenarios.name: approval-boundary
scenarios.initialState: A consequential backend-owned action requires approval.
expectedLucyBehavior: Expose one exact pending approval identity
Explain mutation, reason, verification and rollback
scenarios.backendIdentity: pending approval must match current conversation/session identity
scenarios.primaryGap: Chat does not yet carry and surface structured reason, verification plan, and rollback plan for a consequential approval boundary; real-provider acceptance is also gated by #210.

scenarios.name: bare-approval
scenarios.initialState: Zero, one, or multiple backend-owned pending approvals may be observed.
expectedLucyBehavior: Bind only one unambiguous current approval
Return opaque approvalId for backend re-verification
Fail closed on none, ambiguity, expiry or identity mismatch
scenarios.backendIdentity: approval candidate and current conversation/session must match exactly
observableEvidence: one approvalId or explicit binding failure
no protected action before backend confirmation
currentSourceEvidence: e2e/chat.spec.ts: fails closed on unbound 승인
e2e/chat.spec.ts: accepts one bound pending approval
scenarios.primaryGap: Provider-backed approval acceptance is gated by #210.

scenarios.name: tool-runtime-progress
scenarios.initialState: A real run is in progress.
forbiddenBehavior: Expose raw tool arguments or secrets
Present transport events as the primary conversation
scenarios.backendIdentity: progress events correlate to current run/session
currentSourceEvidence: server/adapters/http.ts currently accepts native status strings verbatim
server/collaboration-runner.ts forwards adapter status as run.status
scenarios.primaryGap: Native backend status text is not yet bounded/redacted before it reaches run.status/transcript, so raw arguments, paths, or credentials could be exposed; real-provider acceptance is also gated by #210.

scenarios.name: failure-recovery
scenarios.initialState: Backend/tool execution fails or cannot be verified.
expectedLucyBehavior: Retry only when safe and bounded
scenarios.backendIdentity: failure evidence belongs to current run/session
currentSourceEvidence: e2e/chat.spec.ts covers failure -> 왜 안돼? -> blocker/next action -> 계속해 with mock success

scenarios.name: artifact-generation
scenarios.initialState: The current task produces one or more artifacts.
expectedLucyBehavior: Bind it to the task/run that produced it
currentSourceEvidence: current ArtifactRecord does not persist runId/task ownership after the transient artifact.created event
scenarios.primaryGap: Persisted artifacts do not yet retain verifiable producing run/task ownership across reload or after the response stream is gone; #238 tracks the bounded source fix. Real-provider generated-artifact acceptance is also gated by #210.

scenarios.name: session-continuity

expectedLucyBehavior: Preserve active task and approval binding
Do not cancel a run merely because another room is selected
forbiddenBehavior: Create a second logical task silently
scenarios.backendIdentity: restored context must match persisted conversation/session identity
scenarios.primaryGap: Fresh exact-main real-provider continuity/browser acceptance is gated by #210.

scenarios.name: worker-agent-identity
